campaign: Deliver multimodal Qwen3.8-Flash-Next UD-IQ4_XS and meet native Strata performance

paragraphs.text: The scorecard's gaps generate the work (check: cmd/loop TestScorecardGapsBecomeProposals, cmd/loop TestTheGapsAreFiledOnceTheScorecardPublishes, cmd/loop TestADeclineBecomesTheRowTheLoopWorks). Progress is each scorecard cell against its previous measurement, not a count of landings (check: internal/scorecard TestEarlierIsEachCellsNewestEarlierMeasurement, cmd/loop TestCycleComparesWithTheNewestEarlierScorecardWithoutAMain). There is no passed state (check: cmd/gate TestCompletionAuthorityGone, internal/plan TestLivePlanRejectsRetainedCompletionState).

One run serves every obligation whose identity and contract match, written once as one record with many readers (check: cmd/loop TestMeasurementRunsNoCaseAgainAfterAnUnrelatedCommit, internal/evaluation TestEvaluationAtAnUnchangedPlanReusesItsCampaign, internal/capabilityruntime TestStoredResultIsReusedOnlyUnderItsOwnIdentity). A run never judges what it produced (check: internal/runrecord TestProposerEvaluatorDeciderAuthorityDomainsAndPriorGeneration, internal/trainingworkflow TestHeldoutRunTrainsOnlyOnTrainingRecords, internal/runrecord TestTrainingDecisionWithholdsPromotionUntilEvaluation). Every contract a comparison reads and every retained protocol is a cell of its model, which a full run measures when it is given the model (check: cmd/validate TestEveryComparedContractHasACell, cmd/validate TestCycleRunsWhatPromotionCompares, cmd/validate TestAFullRunMeasuresTheModelsItWasGiven).

The gate's verdict depends only on the tree, and suites that load real models, read the live store or sweep the device run in the cycle's lanes by build tag, never the gate's (check: internal/landing TestReachInvariants, internal/landing TestLaneSelectionUsesTheLaneBuildContext, internal/landing TestAudioLaneOptsIntoTheStoreAcceptance). The cycle measures at the commit it began at, in its own checkout (check: cmd/loop TestCycleRunsInItsOwnCheckout). A landing's cost is read from its diff, the lanes it reaches through its test binaries' closure and the pinned media it stales (check: internal/landing TestLaneReachSkipsOtherPackagesTests, internal/landing TestPreflightNamesPinnedBytes). A move of a model's own identity puts its cases again (check: internal/evaluation TestAnswersOutliveOnlyTheCommitsThatLeaveTheirCodeUnchanged, internal/inferencesurface TestEvaluationIdentityIsItsModelsWithTheSourcesThatAskIt). A cycle starts once the measured surface moved (check: cmd/loop TestLoopStartsACycleWhenTheMeasuredSurfaceMoved). Dependency work is verified through its test closure and the guard surface, which stops at overgodb and runrecord (check: internal/inferencesurface TestSurfaceCoversEmbeddedInputsAndModules, internal/inferencesurface TestSurfaceInvariants). A suite moved out of the gate still reaches a cycle lane (check: internal/landing TestReachInvariants, internal/trainingworkflow TestEveryRetiredLifecycleFailureIsStillCaught). The landing scorecard reports and never refuses (check: internal/landing TestLandingMeasuresTheScorecardSlice). The gate writes the numbers a landing message carries (check: internal/landing TestLanesMeasurementLine, internal/landing TestLandingSaysWhatAChangeAddsOfEachKind).

Before a landing the preflight runs the cheap stages alone, format, fix, vet, rules, invariants and the step's check (check: internal/landing TestPreflightRunsTheCheapStagesOnly, internal/landing TestGeneratorsAreThoseTheRepositoryHas).

Each structural boundary is pinned as a row of its kind's invariant table (check: internal/landing TestReachInvariants, internal/inferencesurface TestSurfaceInvariants). The gate writes each landing's lanes skipped, lane walls, and packages executed and cached (check: internal/landing TestLanesMeasurementLine, internal/landing TestRanPackagesNamesOnlyWhatRan). No fixed timer comes back, nor the deleted baselines and tracking records (check: internal/repoanalysis TestNoFixedTimers, cmd/gate TestClosureLedgerGone, cmd/gate TestGateRecordsGone).

A journey is timed from action to usable result, with loading, waiting, execution and display apart (check: cmd/recipe TestMeasurementSeparatesLoadPrefillAndVisibleOutput, internal/server TestWebUIBrowserShowsTheFirstTokenTime, internal/server TestCancelledDownloadHoldsItsSlotUntilItFinishes). One gate run serves every step it lands (check: internal/landing TestLandingCompletesSeveralSteps). Validation and reuse are scoped by actual dependencies, and one that cannot be named keeps the wider scope (check: internal/inferencesurface TestCapabilityIdentityMovesOnlyWithItsOwnSources, internal/capabilityruntime TestStoredResultIsReusedOnlyUnderItsOwnIdentity, cmd/validate TestBenchmarkDoesNotReuseUnknownExecution).

A full measurement run continues only at the commit it began at (check: cmd/loop TestUnfinishedCycleContinuesAtItsOwnCommit, cmd/loop TestInterruptedCycleResumesAtItsFirstUnpassedPhase). Landings go on beside a run, waiting only for the device turn, with the checkout free (check: internal/landing TestALandingBesideARunWaitsOnlyForTheDevice, internal/landing TestALandingWaitingOnARunLeavesTheCheckoutFree).

The repository tracks no Python, and its runtime is Go (check: internal/repoanalysis TestPythonLivesOnlyInItsIgnoredPlace, internal/repoanalysis TestRSIRuntimeIsGoOnly). A row's acceptance is fixed before its code, every open step having a check and a change judged by the check its row held before it (check: internal/plan TestOpenStepRequiresVerifier, internal/landing TestChangeIsJudgedByTheTermsItStartedWith). A reader of a record form the store holds stays while the store holds it (check: internal/runrecord TestStageReceiptOfTheEarlierFormIsRead, internal/runrecord TestRetiredGateAliasesAtRest). A pilot not accepted leaves the served path, and its record is kept and read (check: cmd/train TestTheRewardPilotIsRetired, cmd/training-objective TestTheRewardPilotIsRetired, internal/evaluation TestInstructionPilotRecordIsTheAcceptanceItNames, cmd/train TestProposalRetirementPreservesTrainingAndEvidence).

A change grows production code no more than its row's count, read from the commit it builds on, so a consolidation pays for what it adds with what it deletes, and an item's count covers all its landings (check: internal/landing TestItemsGrowthIsChargedAcrossItsLandings, internal/landing TestChangeIsJudgedByTheTermsItStartedWith). A count is raised with a reason of its own (check: internal/landing TestLandingRaisesItsOwnCount, cmd/plan TestSetCountWritesTheCountAndItsReason). Test code, fixtures, record schemas and CUDA source are reported with each landing and not refused (check: internal/landing TestLandingSaysWhatAChangeAddsOfEachKind, internal/landing TestWrittenCodeIsCountedByKind). A new export has a consumer outside its package (check: internal/landing TestExportUseCountsConsumers).

A stored result is reused only under unchanged identity of code, model, recipe, data, settings and request, and a fresh request always runs (check: internal/capabilityruntime TestStoredResultIsReusedOnlyUnderItsOwnIdentity, internal/capabilityruntime TestFreshRunExecutesWhatAnIdenticalRequestStored, cmd/validate TestResumedRunStartsAgainACellWhoseWeightsChanged). Eligibility is kept apart from selection, observations from scores, and choosing records from confirming ones (check: internal/trainingworkflow TestSelectionNeverRestoresEligibility, internal/evaluation TestScoringFixRunsNoCaseAgain, internal/evaluation TestConfirmationIsChargedBeforeThePromotionPartIsRead).

An experiment's acceptance is frozen before it trains, from the store's cases and never from its arms (check: internal/evaluation TestInstructionAcceptanceBindsProtocolGroupsAndComparisons, internal/evaluation TestHeldOutPoolIsSizedForItsDeclaredGain).

items.title: Settle the provenance of code that cites Torch and CUTLASS

budget.reason: Kernel licences in the bill are hard-coded (cmd/sbom/main.go:104-108), so naming a source needs a few lines of code.

steps.title: Add the notices the answer requires
steps.rationale:
kernels/cuda/ops_f32.cu:1584,6579 and ops_native.cu:64 cite Torch 7661cd9c and CUTLASS da5e086d, ops_f32.cu:2366 names 'pinned Torch CUDA owners', and torch_cuda_randn.cu:1 reads 'Ported verbatim from adaptive_new'. licenses/ and SBOM.cdx.json hold no notice for either project. If code was copied, BSD terms require one. The answer belongs to decision kernel-provenance.
go run ./cmd/sbom -check exits 0 today (measured), so it proves nothing here; the new test reads the cited sources. Rewording a comment changes source hashes, so the manifest and bill update with it.
Serves: a clean release.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: the notice files and the regenerated bill of materials.
Batch: claims lane.

budget.reason: catalog-choice measured -84 production nodes against its estimate of -60: one catalog choice where four stood and one lineage comparator where two did; the row's later steps carry their own measured deletions.

steps.title: Take the cell step records' window from Reads
steps.rationale:
SQA-234: CellAttentionAttributes.steps repeats the window bounds Reads owns; steps takes them from Reads.
Serves: one statement of a cell's window.
Disappears: the duplicate initialization and condition, about 21 nodes.
Evidence: the existing cell attention tests.
Batch: with whichever row next opens internal/tensor/builder_cell.go.

SQA-219 and SQA-227 join this step, each one line beside it in weight: encodeF32 takes driver.Bytes, and validateCache borrows the positions it only reads.

SQA-217 and the CUDA folds compact-production/surface-folds held back join this step, since any change under internal/cuda/driver or internal/cuda/executor runs the device lane in full, which waits on compact-production/adaptiveparity-lane: the graph cache matches the retained compiled graph and the exact frame, compiledSerials and both serial fields going with the graph-drop test's second-compile tail; the two strata recorders' side-stream switch is one onStream over their device state; and the driver's version and device count read through one int32Out. TestSurfaceRepeatsStayUnderTheirCeiling's ceilings fall by what the folds remove.

TestSurfaceRepeatsStayUnderTheirCeiling is now the subtest inside the inference surface of TestRepeatedProductionBodiesStayUnderTheirCeiling, which reads the checkout once for every repeat and forwarder ceiling; its two surface ceilings fall by what the folds remove.

The register's test reductions in internal/cuda/executor's tests join this step from compact-tests/sqa-reductions, since a change to them runs the device lane in full: SQA-204, the full-rank doorbell cases into the captured-execution table; SQA-209, replay metrics into the reference replay test; SQA-220, the smaller-after-growth arena check into the metrics test; SQA-166, the verify-span graph into the decode graph fixture; SQA-188, the prefill attention cases into the flash attention table; SQA-174, worker statistics in the MoE and read-back tests; and SQA-230, each QSA and cell parity graph built once for its two backends.

items.title: Give each repeated mechanism one home

budget.reason: Estimate, unmeasured. The folds delete more than they add; package-digests and one-layer-walk move the inference surface and its pins.

steps.title: Compute every code identity from one package digest graph
steps.rationale:
Measure first: list each computation's package set at HEAD; where they disagree is a finding. Five computations decide what a change reaches, each with its own roots, pruning and file rules: the surface digest (internal/inferencesurface/surface.go:28-50, recorded only by internal/longform), execution identities (internal/inferencesurface/identity.go:85-305), the run key's code scope (internal/capabilityruntime/run_key.go:26-65), the loop's cycle trigger (cmd/loop/trigger.go:25-61) and lane reach (internal/landing/lanes.go:494-556) (all unverified).
One go list -deps -test -json per commit gives each package a digest over its files and its dependencies' digests; each identity becomes a query over it. Identities move, so the census and pinned digests move with it in one commit.
Serves: development velocity.
Disappears: four closure walks.
Evidence: package sets before and after, equal except where a finding says why.
Batch: one commit with the other surface moves, before one measurement run.

steps.title: Walk a model's layers in one loop
steps.rationale:
The walk over layers is written at least eight times (internal/inference/runner_layers.go:14,176,220,350,405, sequence_forward.go:249,278, device_cache.go:1740) and the decode loop at least five (runner_generation.go:484, host_generation.go:16, nextn_device_speculation.go:286, strata_round_generate.go:171, continuous_generation.go:173) (all unverified). Sharing weights across a batch works only for gated-delta models (internal/model/forward_program.go:83, unverified), which shows a gain in one copy not reaching the others.
Fold the layer walks first, outputs bit-identical, one model family at a time, each with its bench; the decode loops follow as their own step once this one shows what it cost.
Serves: inference; every later speed change reaches every model.
Disappears: seven copies of the layer walk.
Evidence: decoded texts and benches equal per family.
Batch: one commit with the other surface moves, before one measurement run.

steps.title: Hold each resource by one lock
steps.rationale:
Measure first: list each lock with the resource it guards. About ten exist: gate.lock (internal/authoritylock), landing_turn.lock (internal/landing/turn.go:81), the cycle lock (cmd/loop/improve.go:381), two leftovers locks (cmd/loop/leftovers.go:273,1182), the campaign lock (internal/processcontrol/campaign.go:67), stop.lock (internal/plan/control.go:233), the lane turn (internal/landing/lanes.go:240-247), the device-lane lease (cmd/device-lane/admission.go:77) and the guard's holder file (all unverified). One landing waited 7h59m for a turn (e63fd568a).
Merge the locks that guard the same resource (checkout, card, store, plan).
Serves: development velocity.
Disappears: locks with no resource of their own.
Evidence: the list, and turn waits across a week.
Batch: host lane.

items.title: Run the checks that exist but reach little

budget.reason: Workflow and script changes; no production Go grows.

steps.title: Run the race detector over every host package
steps.rationale:
-race appears only at .github/workflows/test.yml:68, on Ubuntu, for two packages. Commit checks never use it, and CI runs only when a push is asked for. Device code under *_windows.go (19,752 lines in 100 files) cannot compile there.
Widen the job. For device code, weigh a cgo-enabled Windows run in a separate build; measure its wall before adding it.
Serves: concurrency faults found before a run.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: a full job log.
Batch: CI only; goes with the next push.

steps.title: Run fuzz-smoke or remove it, and remove stall_check
steps.rationale:
Nothing calls scripts/fuzz-smoke.sh or scripts/stall_check.sh, so ten fuzz targets run only their seeds. Run alone, the script is wrong too: FuzzSessionStateNeverPanics exists nowhere and exits 0 ('no fuzz tests to fuzz'), and FuzzFrontend, FuzzTemplate and FuzzAudioDecode are left out, so 7 of 10 run (measured).
Derive the list from the tree, add a scheduled job with a short duration, and delete stall_check.sh. The first check, a grep of the workflow, a comment could satisfy.
Serves: parser and template faults found by mutation.
Disappears: one unused script and a hand-kept list.
Evidence: a job log.
Batch: CI only.

items.title: Make the unattended driver start and keep working

budget.reason: Estimate. One init command and a wait in the existing driver. If decision driver-future chooses removal, this row deletes the driver instead.

steps.title: Start the driver from one config file
steps.rationale:
go run ./cmd/loop still does not start from a checkout. The store half is repaired (cmd/loop/main.go:144). It still needs .overgo-runtime/loop.json (:202-209) naming a worker (:210) and an exact profile strategy_id (:261), that strategy and its prompt in the store (:264-276), to publish it a spec (cmd/loop/evidence.go:27-31) naming an agent definition whose only door is the server (internal/server/agent_control.go:111,336-357) plus a catalog, a policy and a model recipe (internal/recipe/agent.go:71-75), and OVERGO_AUTOMATION_WORKER set (main.go:220, internal/processcontrol/campaign.go:57-59).
Subtract instead of adding an -init. The driver uses only the strategy's Loop (:240), Prompt (:273) and ID, and nothing reads the ID's environment value (:364-371). Put a prompt file, the two budgets and the worker name in loop.json, and take -publish-strategy out of the start. The prompt already goes by argv and stdin (:337-340,372).
ObligationWorld has no non-test implementer (internal/loop/driver.go:72-81,145,152), yet skill.md:177 cites its test. Wire it or remove both.
Serves: setup-steps, and hours of unattended work.
Disappears: the strategy record at start, OVERGO_STRATEGY and OVERGO_STRATEGY_ID, and the .cmd hand step.
Evidence: a fixture start from an empty state directory.
Batch: host lane.

steps.title: End a run that finds work waiting as waiting, not as an error
steps.rationale:
Partly repaired since filing: the driver waits on the lock (cmd/loop/main.go:290,321-323), and decisions no longer wait (internal/plan/dispatch.go:234-243). What remains is a stop, which Paused handles first, and another lane's rows (dispatch.go:246).
The live fault is after a worker exits: a dispatch found waiting there returns reason '' with 'loop: re-read plan: ...' (internal/loop/driver.go:240-243, measured), where :164-167 gives a waiting reason, and :179-181 reports plan-complete with an error. internal/loop/dispatch_wait_test.go:17 pins the current return. Wake on the plan's commit or a released lock, a signal and not a timer, as doctrine requires.
WorkerTimeoutMinutes defaulting to 90 (main.go:213-215) is a fixed timer the same doctrine refuses, and a landing can outlast it: bound by the landing's own signals.
SQA-258 and SQA-271 land here: the supervising process awaits the run through the first-start driver, so a detached launcher exit is never read as run success and a finished or failed run is acted on without a nudge. sqa-cycle/run-continuation was retired into this step, as SQA-271 directs.
Serves: unattended runtime.
Disappears: the 90-minute default.
Evidence: a world that releases a row after one wait, and a waiting plan after a worker exits.
Batch: loop lane.

items.title: Test one composite model: give Qwen3.5-9B vision through a trained bridge

budget.reason: Estimate 1,000 to 1,300: the gradient through a frozen text model is new, and the encoder-bridge route computes no gradient today.

steps.title: Freeze the comparison before any training
steps.rationale:
The experiment asks one question: does a small host encoder plus a trained projector give Qwen3.5-9B useful vision at far less card memory than a native vision model? Qwen3.5-9B peaks at 9.0 GiB, Qwen3.8-27B at 22.3 GiB.
Fix before training: the suite, the required gain, the split, the limits on card memory and first output, and a limit on GPU-hours. A full-stack 9B step took about 3 min 4 s (docs/verification/qwen35-9b-fullstack-training-run.txt:87-90), so a thousand steps is about 51 hours; Qwen2.5-0.5B took 0.47 s a step. A bounded run on 0.5B comes first, and if it shows no gain the row ends with a record.
No download is needed: VidGen clips, captions and frames should be on disk, and evaluate -build-caption-matching takes a seed and a case count (cmd/evaluate/main.go:93-97). Confirm the data is there. Held-out clips and their source videos stay out of training.
Confirm that RxBrain's 0.63 and Qwen3.8-27B's 0.92 rest on this suite (README.md:121-122,134); if not, read both on it. At 64 cases one reading's standard error is 0.061 at 0.63, so build a larger suite if the required gain is smaller than that can detect.
Include a floor (a constant answer) and a ceiling (27B).
Serves: held-out-quality and peak-device-memory.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: an acceptance record published before the first training step.
Batch: evaluation lane.

steps.title: Score the seam from measured representations
steps.rationale:
The Score function in cmd/seam-align returns the value in its input file (cmd/seam-align/main.go:228-234), so a recorded score proves nothing about the two models. The command has no test file yet.
Capture real encoder outputs and real text embeddings over the training split, then rank DINO's pooled and patch outputs and the bridge operators by alignment residual (internal/composition/alignment_residual.go:24) before GPU-hours are spent.
A residual is a cheap estimate: AlignmentResidualBiasAudit (:183) holds it to measured parity once bridges are trained.
Serves: GPU-hours go only to likely connections.
Disappears: the hand-supplied score.
Evidence: residuals from captured tensors, and a planted unrelated pair that scores badly.
Batch: host lane.

steps.title: Serve a composition through a recipe
steps.rationale:
ProductionComposition holds capture, transform and inject (internal/inference/representation_bridge.go:260-343), but no command reaches it: it is listed as prototype in internal/repoanalysis/testdata/unreached_declarations.txt (lines 68, 72, 136-145).
Reach it from a recipe, keeping capture and transform. Drop inject: it overrides every target token and refuses any other shape (:322-340), so it is not placeholder injection. The placeholder path is internal/inference/multimodal_prompt.go:32 and runner_projected.go:309, and a second path is what this row forbids. The recipe names encoder, bridge and text model by identity, and both models stay frozen.
Serves: a composite is a servable capability rather than a test object.
Disappears: inject, and its entries in the unreached list.
Evidence: a small composite answering through a recipe on the host.
Batch: serving lane.

steps.title: Train the projector through the frozen text model
steps.rationale:
This needs a new training path. The encoder-bridge route fits an affine map to a decoder's tokens, with no gradient and no text model (cmd/train/route_encoder_bridge.go:316-319), and internal/bridgetrain takes the caller's Gradients (train.go:40-43), though it does train only the bridge and proves both models unchanged.
The loss is caption tokens through the frozen text model, the row's main technical risk: a backward pass through Q8_0 weights on the device. The hybrid-stack route computes one for 9B but updates weights as it walks (docs/verification/qwen35-9b-fullstack-training-run.txt:31-33), so the frozen walk is new.
The bridge starts at zero output, so the untrained composite equals the text model alone, as internal/densecausal/graft.go:14-22 does.
Measure one step, then hold the GPU-hours the terms fixed. Smallest first: Qwen2.5-0.5B, then 9B only if 0.5B gained.
Serves: the cheapest kind of training the system can judge, since only a small adapter changes.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: a fixture run, its checkpoint record and frozen-model proof.
Batch: training lanes.

steps.title: Judge the composite, then keep or remove it
steps.rationale:
Read the composite, floor and ceiling on the frozen held-out suite with exposure charged, and retain the record, which the check reads: a model-tagged test would train in every run (internal/landing/lanes.go:85-89,134). Report quality, peak card memory, throughput and first output side by side; the host encoder alone reads 4.5 s today (README.md:144), which may decide the result.
A win publishes an inactive candidate, activated through close-the-loop or by hand. A composite has no slot yet, so its activation is by hand until that row lands.
A loss keeps one record under docs/verification and removes what this row added, as the doctrine asks of a null result. A projector matching a native vision model is an open question, and a clear loss is a valid outcome.
Either result feeds the seam-align bias audit.
Serves: held-out-quality and peak-device-memory, on evidence.
Disappears: on a loss, this row's wiring.
Evidence: one retained verdict, whichever way it goes.
Batch: one device run by the row; the check is host lane.

decisions.question: Download the unquantized google/gemma-4-12B-it? The 12B FP8 twins score 0.5-1.2 nats per token worse than E4B on the guard corpus while overgo's 12B graph matches the transformers reference, so the third-party quant is the suspect.
options: Download it
Keep only the FP8 twins and record the gap
decisions.recommendation: Download it
decisions.answer: Download it

decisions.question: The capability census changed from 209 recorded identities to 220 live ones. Record a disposition that accepts the live census as the new denominator?
options: Review the 11 new identities, then accept
Accept the live census as it stands
decisions.recommendation: Review the 11 new identities, then accept
decisions.answer: Review the 11 new identities, then accept

decisions.question: Four test groups need references only the Python originals produce: the Fractale leadership tests, Krea, Pocket TTS and the Qwen3.5 projector fixture. What happens to them?
options: Delete those a running test covers, keep the rest waiting
Allow one Python run to produce the references
Keep all waiting
decisions.recommendation: Delete those a running test covers, keep the rest waiting
decisions.answer: Allow one Python run to produce the references

decisions.question: When validate-currency is otherwise ready, should the Qwen3.5-9B hybrid training proof (22m05 a cycle, the same cmd/train route and code as the blocking 4B proof) move to the background, so promotion stops waiting on every training proof? Background saves about 22 min a cycle; the 4B proof still guards the route.
options: background
blocking
decisions.recommendation: background
decisions.answer: background

decisions.question: The scorecard's serving cells (first-output, throughput, load-time, peak-device-memory) aggregate every attempt a recipe ever made: medians over all time, total tokens over total decode time, the highest peak ever. A landed improvement shows only as old samples are outnumbered and a peak never falls. Since delete-selection each cycle measures every serving cell once at the measured commit. Should those cells read the newest successful measured attempt instead, accepting one sample's timing noise in each cycle's moved list?
options: newest measured attempt
all-time aggregates
median of the newest few attempts
decisions.recommendation: newest measured attempt
decisions.answer: newest measured attempt

decisions.question: Held-out quality is unscored for forecast, image-embedding, image-gen, seq2seq, tabular and vqa because each needs a held-out set the store lacks. Answering authorizes exactly these downloads into the datasets root, each to be verified by hash once fetched: ETTh1 (github.com/zhouhaoyi/ETDataset, 2.6 MB, forecast); BFCL v3 simple (gorilla-llm/Berkeley-Function-Calling-Leaderboard, 0.3 MB, seq2seq); BeyondArena credit-g (TabArena/BeyondArena, 0.2 MB, tabular); TIFA v1.0 (github.com/Yushi-Hu/tifa, 10 MB, image-gen); A-OKVQA validation (HuggingFaceM4/A-OKVQA, 60 MB, vqa); Imagenette 160 px (fast.ai imagenette2-160, 100 MB, image-embedding). About 173 MB in all. The other five unscored rows (generation, projection, speech, training, video-gen) use sets already on disk and are not blocked.
options: Download all six (about 173 MB)
Download only the four under 11 MB (ETTh1, BFCL, credit-g, TIFA)
Download none and score only what is on disk
decisions.recommendation: Download all six (about 173 MB)
decisions.answer: Download only the four under 11 MB (ETTh1, BFCL, credit-g, TIFA)

decisions.question: The remaining models under adaptive_new/models (Wan, the Gemma configs and others) are read by tests through variables that point outside the repository, which cost environment-dependent skips. May they be copied into overgo_data/models, one model at a time, each copy verified (hash, servable identity, baseline lookup, bounded inference) before its locator switches, with the originals left in place and adaptive_new never written to?
options: Copy one at a time, verified, originals kept
Leave adaptive_new as the models' home
decisions.recommendation: Copy one at a time, verified, originals kept
decisions.answer: Copy one at a time, verified, originals kept

decisions.question: Held-out quality is unscored for generation (Fractale-350M-base) because the held-out text the proposal names, the WikiText-2 test split (Salesforce/wikitext, wikitext-2-raw-v1, 0.7 MB), is not on disk: only wikitext2_train.txt is, which a model may have trained on. Answering authorizes exactly this one download into the datasets root.
options: Download the WikiText-2 test split (about 0.7 MB)
Score generation on a held-out membership of the on-disk training articles instead
Download nothing and leave generation unscored
decisions.recommendation: Download the WikiText-2 test split (about 0.7 MB)
decisions.answer: Download the WikiText-2 test split (about 0.7 MB)

decisions.question: gemma-4-12B-it-fp8 (the non-native file) is slower, heavier and slower to load than the native file at equal held-out quality (31.1 tok/s, 31.1 s load, 22.5 GiB against 41.5 tok/s, 22.6 s, 14.7 GiB; 0.4919 against 0.4926; the native file now decodes at 45 tok/s and loads in 7.5 s). Does it still serve anything that justifies the device time of its eight cycle cells and any optimization?
options: Keep it registered and measured, spend no optimization time on it
Retire it from the cycle and keep the file
Delete the file
decisions.recommendation: Keep it registered and measured, spend no optimization time on it
decisions.answer: Keep it registered and measured, spend no optimization time on it

decisions.question: Editing a pinned media runtime path (go.mod, kernels, internal/cuda, tensor, devicemath and the rest of docs/image_video_merged.json's runtime paths) needs a reviewed delta: a device receipt, a delta entry, and the registry's identity pinned in a test, built by hand twice on 2026-10-04 and again for every kernel row ahead (e4b-decode-graph, decode-small-kernels). It exists so media evidence acquired at the pinned runtime stays valid across an output-neutral edit. Since the cycle re-acquires every media cell at the commit it promotes, and its models lane runs the media acceptance tests against the frozen references, the evidence that gate protects is re-proved every cycle: it is the same per-cell currency check validate-currency deleted. Retire the registry, its pin and the gate-time check (about 600 lines of test code, the registry JSON and the landing's pinned-path rule), or keep it and build a one-command tool for it (row media-delta-command)?
options: Retire the pin, the registry and the gate-time check; the cycle's media acceptance holds the contract
Keep the pin and build the one-command delta tool (media-delta-command)
decisions.recommendation: Retire the pin, the registry and the gate-time check; the cycle's media acceptance holds the contract
decisions.answer: Retire the pin, the registry and the gate-time check; the cycle's media acceptance holds the contract

decisions.question: Speech, image-gen and video-gen quality cannot be scored by the model alone: pocket-tts outputs audio, the image generators pictures, Wan2.1 and Un-0 clips. Each proposal scores the output by a second local model: a speech recognizer for round-trip word error rate, a vision-language model for TIFA questions and for matching a clip to its caption. evaluate has no suite in which a generator's output is judged by another model, and a record must name both the generator's recipe, which the scorecard reads, and the judge's identity, which the score depends on. One judged-generation suite kind (the projection session already shows a video to Qwen3.8-27B) would serve all three rows and their eight models, with a new session for each judge modality.
options: Build one judged-generation suite kind for speech, image-gen and video-gen
Score speech by its recognizer round trip only, and leave image-gen and video-gen unscored
Leave all three unscored
decisions.recommendation: Build one judged-generation suite kind for speech, image-gen and video-gen
decisions.answer: Build one judged-generation suite kind for speech, image-gen and video-gen

decisions.question: Held-out quality of training is scored for a recipe only by a train -objective session, which publishes a held-out verdict. Qwen2.5-0.5B trains through that route and now has its verdict (a token-prediction objective over a held-out third of the WikiText-2 articles). The other six training recipes belong to routes that prove the route rather than score text: Qwen3.5-4B and 9B hybrid-stack (a bounded observed full-stack run whose evidence is that loss descends), Wan2.1 and LiveEdit dit, Hy-Embodied mot. None of those routes holds out data or scores a model, and a token-prediction objective does not fit a diffusion or a mixture-of-transformers model. Scoring them means giving each route a held-out objective of its own (days of work each, and a 20-step proof run's held-out value says little). Which do you want?
options: Declare the proof-route recipes' held-out quality not applicable, stating that their sessions prove a route
Give each proof route a held-out objective and score its recipe
Leave the proof-route recipes unscored
decisions.recommendation: Declare the proof-route recipes' held-out quality not applicable, stating that their sessions prove a route
decisions.answer: Declare the proof-route recipes' held-out quality not applicable, stating that their sessions prove a route

decisions.question: adaptive_new/models holds about 430 GB in 20 model directories (Krea-2-Turbo 116 GB, SenseNova-U1 66, bonzai 40, Wan2.1 33, LiveEdit 32, gemma-4-E4B 30, gemma-4-12B-fp8 29, Hy-Embodied 24, Qwen3.5-4B 18, Unlimited-OCR 13, pocket-tts 9, Qwen3.5-9B 9, then eight under 5 GB), and C: has 536 GB free at 86% full. The answer to adaptive-new-model-copies kept every original, so copying all of them leaves about 100 GB free. Which models should move into overgo_data/models now?
options: Copy the models under 10 GB now, and decide the large ones separately
Copy every model, originals kept (leaves about 100 GB free)
Copy the models under 10 GB now and leave the large ones where they are, their test variables kept
Copy the large ones too, then delete the originals after each verified copy
decisions.recommendation: Copy the models under 10 GB now, and decide the large ones separately
decisions.answer: Copy the models under 10 GB now, and decide the large ones separately

decisions.question: The ten large models under adaptive_new/models are about 204 GB of working files (their directories hold as much again in git LFS caches), adaptive_new/checkpoints is a further 211 GB and is overgo's configured checkpoints root, and C: has about 495 GB free. Copying all of it while the originals stay does not fit. How should the large models and the checkpoints root leave adaptive_new?
options: Leave them where they are for now, found through local-models.json, and take the hard-coded paths out of the tests

Move them: rename the large model directories and the checkpoints root into overgo_data (same volume, no disk cost, no copy time); this changes adaptive_new, so it needs a decision from outside the system
Copy the large models' working files (about 204 GB, originals kept, leaves about 290 GB free) and leave the checkpoints root in adaptive_new
decisions.recommendation: Leave them where they are for now, found through local-models.json, and take the hard-coded paths out of the tests
decisions.answer: Leave them where they are for now, found through local-models.json, and take the hard-coded paths out of the tests

decisions.question: Master took over the VAE lane on 2026-10-07, to plan it as master sees fit. The lane's own plan is 32 steps, none started, behind about 3000 lines of contracts with no caller. What shape does the work take on master?
options: Five measured rows on master, each lane file ported with its first caller, optional branches unplanned until a proposer is kept
Merge the lane's contracts whole and follow its 32-step plan in order
Keep only the installed-autoencoder capability and its held-out measure, and retire the rest of the campaign
decisions.recommendation: Five measured rows on master, each lane file ported with its first caller, optional branches unplanned until a proposer is kept
decisions.answer: Five measured rows on master, each lane file ported with its first caller, optional branches unplanned until a proposer is kept

decisions.question: Load NVIDIA's cuDNN library for the video codec's convolutions, the way cuBLAS is loaded? It is a new native dependency and a further install for a user, and its results are not guaranteed bit for bit across versions and devices.
options: Load it for the codec comparison
Keep only overgo's own kernels

decisions.answer: Load it for the codec comparison

decisions.question: May a served value differ from the double-precision host reference, within a tolerance written down before the change, when it is held to the model's own code at the precision that code uses?
options: Allow it under a tolerance declared first
Keep value-for-value agreement with the host reference
decisions.recommendation: Allow it under a tolerance declared first
decisions.answer: Allow it under a tolerance declared first

options: Yes, through one queue
Keep one committing session
decisions.recommendation: Yes, through one queue
decisions.answer: Yes, through one queue

decisions.question: The GUI lane's worktree was removed on 2026-10-09 and the lane left what it recommends and did not land in the main checkout, as docs/gui_update_plan.json: a deadline on every browser wait, a top-p control in Settings, the output size shown before an export, the Train tab's samples shown while a run goes, rsLoRA and LoRA+ offered for an adapter run, a few demo datasets, documents turned into a conversation dataset, the resident model kept only when it fits beside a training run, and whether a chat turn needs the request number a workflow run carries, with its notes for starting a lane again. The file is not committed: nothing reads it, the repository keeps no document without a reader, and it is ignored in that checkout so it stays as the lane left it. None of the nine is a row of this plan and none has a session. Who takes them?
options: Rank them into this plan after the rows that move a measured result
Open a GUI lane for them again
Leave them recorded and unranked
decisions.recommendation: Rank them into this plan after the rows that move a measured result
decisions.answer: Rank them into this plan after the rows that move a measured result

decisions.question: identity-carry was filed to carry an evaluation only while the code it depends on is unchanged and to delete the sampled replay. Measured 2026-10-09: 46 of the 87 newest results stand on a replay-carried result, 30 of them carried 19 or 20 times; scoring those 46 in full took 13 hours 55 minutes; the code an evaluation depends on changed on 112 of the last 300 commits and cycles lie hundreds of commits apart, so with the replay deleted every cycle scores them all again, about 14 hours more a cycle. The replay's sample is the same 32 cases every time, so a change that misses them is never seen. What should carrying do?
options: Carry under an unchanged identity, else by a replay whose sample changes each time
Carry only under an unchanged identity and score the rest in full every cycle
Leave carrying as it is
decisions.recommendation: Carry under an unchanged identity, else by a replay whose sample changes each time
decisions.answer: Carry only under an unchanged identity and score the rest in full every cycle

decisions.question: evaluation-chain's last step, acceptance, adds a memory ceiling and a speed target to a held-out pool's acceptance and has a confirmation refuse a candidate with no resource comparison against the base within them. Every candidate the proposer makes today is other weights of the base's shape, so it has the base's memory and speed, and no row in the plan makes another kind of candidate; a served recipe's memory and speed are already read by the scorecard and by the routing decision. When should the step be built?
options: When the first candidate whose memory or speed differs from its base's is proposed
Now, ahead of such a candidate
Not at all: leave memory and speed to the scorecard and the routing decision
decisions.recommendation: When the first candidate whose memory or speed differs from its base's is proposed
decisions.answer: When the first candidate whose memory or speed differs from its base's is proposed

decisions.question: The video codec can now convolve a clip of about ten frames or more through NVIDIA's cuDNN. Measured beside another job on the device: a decode about a third faster, an encode about a fifth, the decoder holding 6.0 GiB where it held 9.6, and every value within one of 255 levels of what overgo's own kernels give. It does so only on a machine where cuDNN is on the search path or in the bin directory CUDA_PATH names. This machine's only copy is inside a Python environment, so it still serves by the kernels and the automated checks skip the library's tests. Installing it is yours to do: cuDNN 9 for CUDA 12, about 800 MB, from NVIDIA under NVIDIA's license. The frozen video clips are the kernels' bytes, and I would accept them again under the library afterwards. Install it here?
options: Install cuDNN 9 here; the lead accepts the frozen video clips again under it
Keep this machine on the kernels; the library stays for machines that have it
Take the library's path back out
decisions.recommendation: Install cuDNN 9 here; the lead accepts the frozen video clips again under it
decisions.answer: Install cuDNN 9 here; the lead accepts the frozen video clips again under it

options: Keep the current likelihood objective; decide any replacement only after calibration in likelihood units
Authorize a separate proposal for document-win frequency with an explicit magnitude safeguard and its own calibration
decisions.recommendation: Keep the current likelihood objective; decide any replacement only after calibration in likelihood units
decisions.answer: Keep the current likelihood objective; decide any replacement only after calibration in likelihood units

keep them

Keep activation by hand and state in the purpose that a person activates

decisions.answer: Keep activation by hand and state in the purpose that a person activates
